intro.text: A sailor on a merchant ship of the Emerald Sea that the Crow's Song raids.

items.text: When the Crow's Song captured his ship, Crow shot dead a sailor Smocke cared about. While his captain bargained with Salay, Smocke levelled a pistol at Crow, and she pointed one right back. Then she shot herself in the head and vines sprang from her face to catch the bullet; his shipmates tackled him, and his gun went off into the sky.
